previous_stable.purpose: Primary regression baseline: exact v4.1.76 published source/tag (9075ea8). Required addon regressions against the published 4.1.76 release block candidate 4.1.77. This carries forward the backpack/Folia stability fixes in 4.1.76 and validates the current Cargo frequency-parser reliability change without a data migration. The 4.1.15 historical floor remains advisory and older saved item formats remain supported.
